BUDGET_GRID.primary: GRID_W9 -- w9's unchanged absolute words 30/45/60, interp 38/53
BUDGET_GRID.rule: the rebased words sit at the same percentiles of the AFTER bank's route-length distribution that w9's words occupy in the BEFORE bank's, rounded to the nearest 5; the interpolation words are the midpoints.  The rule mentions route lengths and nothing else.
BUDGET_GRID.self_check: applying the rule with BEFORE as both source and target returns w9's own grid [30, 45, 60]; the interpolation words come back [38, 52] against w9's [38, 53] because Python rounds 52.5 to even.  Declared, not silently fixed.

MECHANISM.why_one_key_is_fatal: with ONE key the constraint key_order=(c,) admits exactly one pickup of exactly colour c -- which is what the oracle does too -- so BLIND-SEQUENTIAL *is* the oracle on a one-key route
MECHANISM.root_cause_of_the_w9_defect: the >= 2-key property is all-or-nothing per maze and DIRECTIONAL: where it holds, 18/18 cross pairs need >= 2 keys and the REVERSE direction is 0/18 FEASIBLE, because the cut door's key lives on one side of the cut. w9's layer required cross pairs in BOTH directions, so its own symmetry requirement selected for single-key cuts.  See artefacts/probe_direction.txt (13 of 40 mazes) and artefacts/probe_density.txt.

DECLARED_DIFFERENCES_FROM_CMAZE2: The kept set is no longer symmetric in direction: all six agent words sit in the source door-free component and all six target words in the destination one.  Direction is a CONSTANT of the split, not a balanced factor; it cannot confound a held-out comparison because it does not vary, but it is a difference and it is stated.
The >= 2-key screen is applied to the UNSEALED maze, before the walled target is chosen, so the refusal walls cannot be what creates the multi-key structure.
Generator-seed acceptance falls from 0.2000 (before) to ~0.165 (after): the cost of the repair is generator seeds, not code.

Routes are longer -- mean optimum 37.4 -> 65.8 steps -- which is why GRID_REBASED exists.  At w9's unchanged words the split carries 454 training requests against w9's 1208; at the rebased words it carries about 1442.

The WALLED target -- the second refusal condition -- is harder to place: all six target words now sit in one component, so sealing one without breaking the other pairs' >= 2-key routes succeeds on 56 of 96 sites against 93 of 96 before.  504 impossible requests remain (837 before).
DECLARED_NOT_RUN: Any SCORED run.  This spoke is 0/0 by its own task file; no arm is fitted, no store exists, no RESULT row is claimed.
The learned arms, the CLU, the encoder and the pipeline ceiling on the fixed split -- that is hub/read-verb's work, and this file is its precondition, not its result.

A BEFORE bank at seed indices 1 and 2.  Only `before 0` (96 sites) and a 48-site `before 1` pool were built; the BEFORE column is one bank, which is enough because it reproduces w9's published numbers exactly.
Any change to w8_envscout.maze_colour.  The engine, the solver and the exact integer judge are imported, and the judge's file sha256 is recorded so that claim is checkable rather than asserted.
GPU and cluster.  Local CPU only, three concurrent processes.
